name: zone-hunt
description: Peekaboom: native iPhone and Android apps (Capacitor). The game itself is index.html.

scripts.ios:prepare: npm run www && npx cap add ios --packagemanager CocoaPods && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios && node scripts/patch-ios.mjs
scripts.android:prepare: npm run www && npx cap add android && npx capacitor-assets generate --android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
